blurb: Park 400 Camping Club is a member-owned RV camping club located on the beautiful Washington coast. We are different from your typical RV camping club because we are a small member-owned and run organization. All members are part of Park 400 Association, Inc. to enjoy on a PART-TIME basis and IS NOT for members use as their permanent or primary residence.
